title: Local and Vertex AI providers
acceptance: src/ai/providers/local.mjs implements all 8 tasks deterministically; node --test tests/unit/ai/providers/local.test.mjs passes on fixtures in tests/fixtures/ai/ (police report text, repair estimate text, rear-end narrative, injury narrative, glass-only narrative, theft w/o police report) asserting extracted fields and confidence
local output shapes match the shared task I/O shapes in the brief

vertex-claude.mjs uses AnthropicVertex({projectId,region:'global'}), tier models claude-haiku-5-5/claude-sonnet-5-5/claude-opus-5-5, thinking {type:'adaptive'}, output_config json_schema, no tool_choice, no budget_tokens; checks stop_reason==='refusal' before reading content; node --test tests/unit/ai/providers/vertex.test.mjs passes with injected fake SDK clients
vertex-gemini.mjs uses GoogleGenAI({vertexai:true,project,location}) with responseSchema JSON; available() false (no throw) when SDK import fails or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT missing
grep shows no real carrier names, no secrets, no budget_tokens
brief:
Each provider file default-exports a factory (ctx,opts)=>{name,available(),run(task,input,{tier,schema})} returning {output,confidence,explanation,usage,model} or {refusal:true}. S1-AI-01 consumes these; do not edit src/ai/index.mjs. Local (src/ai/providers/local.mjs, may split into src/ai/providers/local/*.mjs): regex/keyword/heuristics: police report number, cited party/at-fault party, loss date, VIN, estimate total, repair shop, damage areas; narrative cues: rear-end/hit-from-behind (other party at fault), injury words (whiplash, ER, ambulance, hospital), glass-only (windshield, chip, crack), theft, fire, CAT (hurricane, hail, flood); severity score from loss type, injuries, drivable, damage areas, estimate total, banded low/medium/high/severe; fraud indicators with code/weight/reason (LOSS_NEAR_INCEPTION, LATE_REPORT, NO_POLICE_REPORT_THEFT, PRIOR_CLAIMS, NARRATIVE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH, ROUND_NUMBER_ESTIMATE) computed from facts passed in; subrogation flag from other-party-at-fault cues, citation of other driver, rear-end; summarize templated plain English; next_best_actions rule list. Confidence values: 0.9 for strong pattern hits, 0.5 weak, 0.2 none. Vertex: lazy dynamic import of @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk and @google/genai inside available()/run, wrapped in try/catch; unavailable when import fails or process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT missing; location from GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION default 'global'. Accept opts.sdk injection for tests. Never crash. Use fictional fixtures only.
SHARED AI TASK I/O SHAPES (all teams code against these; local provider must emit them exactly): ai.run returns {output,provider,model,confidence,explanation,usage,unconfirmed?}. Provider interface (src/ai/providers/<name>.mjs default export factory (ctx,opts)=>{name, available():Promise<boolean>, run(task,input,{tier,schema}):Promise<{output,confidence,explanation,usage,model}|{refusal:true}>}). Outputs: extract_narrative in {text} out {lossType,lossDate,location,injuries:boolean,injuryCues[],atFault:'insured'|'other'|'unknown',cues[]}; extract_document in {kind?,text,filename} out {kind,fields:[{name,value,confidence,provenance:{snippet}}],needsReview}; classify_photo in {filename,metadata?} out {kind:'photo',damageAreas[],vehicle:{make,model,color},fields:[same as above],needsReview}; severity in {facts} out {score 0-100,band,drivers[]}; fraud_signals in {facts} out {score,indicators:[{code,weight,reason}]}; subrogation in {facts} out {flag,reasons[],confidence}; summarize in {facts} out {summary,bullets[]}; next_best_actions in {facts} out {actions:[{code,label,reason,priority}]}. Field names for extracted document facts: policeReportNumber, citedParty, atFaultParty, estimateTotal, repairShop, lossDate, vin, damageAreas.
valueDrivers: works with no cloud AI configured
